function.arguments: {"observation": "The treatment arm has a higher proportion of severe cases (95/193 ≈ 49%) compared to control (21/459 ≈ 4.6%), while control has more mild cases (332/459 ≈ 72%). This indicates that arm assignment is strongly confounded by baseline severity, which is a known predictor of response.", "implication": "Any comparison of response rates between male and female patients across arms must account for baseline severity, as the treatment group includes sicker patients who are less likely to respond.
